mentions.name: moonreview
mentions.description: A local code review tool where an AI agent does the review work immediately, functioning like pull requests but before code reaches GitHub. It runs instead of git status / git diff / magit, lets developers add comments that the agent auto-resolves, and lets them stage hunks they are happy with.
mentions.problem: Corporate code reviews are slow and dumb: people review other people's AI-generated slop and comments get fed back into an agent, so the process can be done upfront by the original developer locally, catching sloppy code before it even reaches GitHub.
mentions.audience: Developers who want to catch sloppy code locally before it reaches GitHub, replacing or complementing existing corporate PR review flows.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I vibe-coded a tiny local code review tool, a bit like pull-requests, but an agent does the work immediately.

https://github.com/antoineMoPa/moonreview

The intended use is to run `moonreview` instead of `git status` / `git diff` or `magit`, but you can add comments and they get auto resolved. You can also stage hunks if you are happy with them.
